thread:
julia_sales: quick heads-up — Delta Park (enterprise) wants a POC with a dedicated pool for their gen-chat workload. They asked for H100s in us-east4, 6 GPUs to start, ability to burst to 12. Need VPC peering + customer-managed KMS. ETA for access? :eyes:

Dinesh_SE: thanks — couple q's: which model size/variant (13B/70B)? expected avg tok/sec per user? concurrency targets?

julia_sales: their ML lead said 70B for best quality, seq len ~1024, target p95 latency <= 220ms, target sustained concurrency ~40 sessions, each ~1 req/sec.

sam_infra: noted. for 70B on H100 we'll recommend 6 GPUs for baseline ~2k tok/s aggregate, burst to 12 for peak. need to confirm if quantized model (4-bit) ok, otherwise capacity jumps ~1.5x.

julia_sales: customer prefers float16 (no lossy quantization) for now. any impact on cost?

Dinesh_SE: fp16 increases GPU memory footprint — might need A100s if memory becomes tight. what's the model checkpoint size? also do they need persistent KV cache across requests?

kai_engineer: ops note — if they want prefix caching across sessions we'll need extra RAM on serving nodes; set `cache_enabled: true` in pool config.

sam_infra: can you provide CIDR and AWS account? we'll also need service account email for VPC peering. timeline ~3 business days after info.

julia_sales: I'll get CIDR/account today. Also they asked about pricing: do we have a POC rate or short-term reserved pricing?

Dinesh_SE: POC: we can offer a 30-day trial discount (~30% off committed pool rate) with a usage cap. For dedicated Reserved, monthly commit pricing applies. I'll DM the exact numbers.

ops-bot: Provisioning ticket created: #PROV-9082 — assignee: sam_infra — status: awaiting-customer-info

julia_sales: awesome. last Q: they'd like API keys to test hosted fallback while dedicated ramps up. can we issue temporary hosted keys scoped to the model?

sam_infra: yes — we can issue a scoped hosted API key (short lived). Security needs the scope list and allowed origins. we'll attach to the provisioning ticket.

Dinesh_SE: I'll prepare a starter pool config. paste below and edit with customer values:

```
{
  "pool_name": "delta-park-poc-1",
  "region": "us-east4",
  "sku": "H100-80GB",
  "initial_gpus": 6,
  "max_burst_gpus": 12,
  "model_variant": "70B-fp16",
  "cache_enabled": true,
  "vpc_peering": {
    "customer_cidr": "<CIDR>",
    "aws_account": "<account-id>",
    "service_account": "infra@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
  }
}
```

julia_sales: perfect — I'll collect CIDR/account + customer legal contact and update ticket. thanks all :pray:

sam_infra: marking blocker: customer KMS required? if yes, provisioning may need SOC review — add in ticket.

ops-bot: PROV-9082 updated: customer-info received? no. waiting.

kai_engineer: fyi, if they later request private deployment (on-prem) the estimate will differ significantly — flag as potential scope shift.

julia_sales: noted. closing loop once I have CIDR. thanks everyone!
